snippet.title: Lone Pine Teaser Trailer
snippet.description: Lone Pine is a 2D adventure game about solo exploring a beautiful, indifferent wilderness. You walk, climb, solve puzzles, uncover mysteries, create the path forward, and survive the journey home as you attempt to be the first to photograph unique and elusive creatures.
